text:
Which statement about hydrogen fuel cells is correct?
A
Hydrogen fuel cells do not produce carbon dioxide.
B
Hydrogen fuel cells do not need oxygen.
C
The waste from a hydrogen fuel cell is an acidic gas.
D
The reaction in a fuel cell is endothermic.

options.label: A
options.text: Hydrogen fuel cells do not produce carbon dioxide.

options.label: B
options.text: Hydrogen fuel cells do not need oxygen.

options.label: C
options.text: The waste from a hydrogen fuel cell is an acidic gas.

options.label: D
options.text: The reaction in a fuel cell is endothermic.
